sentences.en: Ilan Pappe says that Zionism is a settler colonial movement.
sentences.zh: 伊兰·帕佩说，犹太复国主义是一种移民殖民运动。

sentences.en: New settlers are being sent to colonize the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 新的移民正被送往西岸地区进行殖民。

sentences.en: In Algeria, the best lands were allocated to European settlers.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔及利亚，最好的土地分配给了欧洲移民。

senses.zh: 移民，侨民,殖民者,决定者
